title: Council of Ministers Resolution No. 137 of 9 March 2021 on regulation of greenhouse-gas emissions
citation: Постановление Совета Министров Республики Беларусь от 9 марта 2021 г. № 137, National Register 5/48865, published on pravo.by 2021-03-11; renamed and amended by Resolution No. 130 of 2024-02-27 (5/52843)
evidence: Portal card https://pravo.by/document/?guid=3961&p0=C22100137, opened 2026-11-03: "Дата вступления в силу | 12.03.2021", "Национальный правовой Интернет-портал Республики Беларусь, 11.03.2021, 5/48865". Para. 3 of the resolution: "Настоящее постановление вступает в силу после его официального опубликования."
notes: Register row corrected. The brief and the first register row called this "Resolution No. 131 of 14 March 2021". On pravo.by No. 131 of 2021-03-04 is a credit-interest resolution (card C22100131), and the in-force date the row carried (2021-03-12) is that of No. 137 of 2021-03-09; the FAOLEX URL on the old row (blr230605.pdf, 59 pages) is Resolution No. 130 of 2024-02-27. The title is therefore changed to No. 137 (its current name on the portal; the 2021 text is headed "О реализации положений Парижского соглашения к Рамочной конвенции Организации Объединенных Наций об изменении климата"). The stored record is the 2021 text as published: it approves the State cadastre of anthropogenic emissions and the National GHG inventory system, with no duty on companies. The accounting duty for legal entities and entrepreneurs above 15 thousand tonnes CO2e a year, and the rules for limiting emissions, were added by Resolution No. 130 of 2024 (by-res-130-2024, in force 2024-04-26). pravo.by serves no consolidated text of No. 137 (paid ЭТАЛОН-ONLINE only), so there is no record of the amended text. English: no government translation found (law.by, the English face of the portal, lists no translation of this act; minpriroda.gov.by did not answer from the cloud address). Belarusian: pravo.by serves Russian only; the Belarusian text of laws is in the newspaper Звязда and is not stored.

title: Council of Ministers Resolution No. 130 of 27 February 2024 amending Council of Ministers resolutions (greenhouse-gas accounting and limitation rules in Resolution No. 137 of 2021)
citation: Постановление Совета Министров Республики Беларусь от 27 февраля 2024 г. № 130, National Register 5/52843, published on pravo.by 2024-03-05
evidence: Para. 3 of the resolution: "Настоящее постановление вступает в силу с 26 апреля 2024 г." Portal card https://pravo.by/document/?guid=3961&p0=C22400130, opened 2026-11-03: "Дата вступления в силу | 26.04.2024".
notes: Omnibus resolution amending more than twenty Council of Ministers resolutions; the whole text is stored. Item 20 of Annex 1 renames Resolution No. 137 "О регулировании выбросов парниковых газов", restates its Regulation on state and production accounting of GHG emissions (production accounting by legal entities and individual entrepreneurs whose total GHG emissions from the listed activities exceed 15 thousand tonnes CO2e in a calendar year, para. 7) and adds the Regulation on the procedure and conditions of limiting GHG emissions. It implements Law No. 294-Z of 2023 (by-law-294-z-2023). Its preamble cites Law No. 294-Z of 2023 (Art. 2 part 1). This is the act that the FAOLEX URL of the old register row pointed at. English: no government translation found (law.by, the English face of the portal, lists no translation of this act; minpriroda.gov.by did not answer from the cloud address). Belarusian: pravo.by serves Russian only; the Belarusian text of laws is in the newspaper Звязда and is not stored.

title: Law No. 294-Z of 17 July 2023 amending the Law on Environmental Protection (greenhouse-gas duties of legal entities and entrepreneurs, Arts. 76 and 77)
citation: Закон Республики Беларусь от 17 июля 2023 г. № 294-З «Об изменении Закона Республики Беларусь "Об охране окружающей среды"», National Register 2/3014, published on pravo.by 2023-07-25
evidence: Portal card https://pravo.by/document/?guid=3961&p0=H12300294, opened 2026-11-03: "Дата вступления в силу | 26.04.2024". Art. 3 of the Law: "статья 1 – через девять месяцев после официального опубликования настоящего Закона; иные положения – после официального опубликования настоящего Закона."
notes: Art. 1 of this Law sets out the Law of 26 November 1992 No. 1982-XII on Environmental Protection in a new edition ("изложить в новой редакции"), so the stored record is the whole restated Law as enacted in 2023, not a list of changes; it is the nearest free official text of the environmental framework act. Staged entry into force: Art. 1 (including Art. 76 "Обязанности юридических лиц и индивидуальных предпринимателей, осуществляющих хозяйственную и иную деятельность, связанную с выбросами парниковых газов в атмосферный воздух" and Art. 77 "Регулирование воздействия на климат") from 2024-04-26 per the card; the other provisions from publication (2023-07-25 per the portal), which is earlier and was not given its own record. The Law is the statutory basis for Resolution No. 137 as amended (para. 5 of Art. 77 leaves the limitation procedure to the Council of Ministers). The pravo.by card of the Law on Environmental Protection (by-law-env-protection-1992) lists this Law as an amending act. The brief called the statutory basis the Law on Atmospheric Air as amended by 295-Z; the GHG duties sit in this Law instead, and 295-Z moves GHG relations out of the Air Law (see by-law-295-z-2023). English: no government translation found (law.by, the English face of the portal, lists no translation of this act; minpriroda.gov.by did not answer from the cloud address). Belarusian: pravo.by serves Russian only; the Belarusian text of laws is in the newspaper Звязда and is not stored.

title: Law No. 295-Z of 17 July 2023 amending the Law on Protection of Atmospheric Air
citation: Закон Республики Беларусь от 17 июля 2023 г. № 295-З «Об изменении Закона Республики Беларусь "Об охране атмосферного воздуха"», National Register 2/3015, published on pravo.by 2023-07-22
evidence: Portal card https://pravo.by/document/?guid=3961&p0=H12300295, opened 2026-11-03: "Дата вступления в силу | 23.01.2024". Art. 5 of the Law: "статьи 1–3 – через шесть месяцев после официального опубликования настоящего Закона; иные положения – после официального опубликования настоящего Закона."
notes: The brief cited this amending law as "No. 295-Z" with the Minprirody note citing 293-Z: confirmed 295-Z on pravo.by (293-Z of 2011-07-14 is an earlier amending law of the Air Law, listed on the card of 2-Z). The Law restates the scope clause so that "Отношения, связанные с выбросами парниковых газов в атмосферный воздух, регулируются законодательством об охране окружающей среды" and removes "и парниковых газов" from several provisions: it takes GHG out of the Air Law and leaves them to the Environmental Protection Law (by-law-294-z-2023). Other provisions from publication (2023-07-22). English: no government translation found (law.by, the English face of the portal, lists no translation of this act; minpriroda.gov.by did not answer from the cloud address). Belarusian: pravo.by serves Russian only; the Belarusian text of laws is in the newspaper Звязда and is not stored.

title: Law No. 2-Z of 16 December 2008 on Protection of Atmospheric Air
citation: Закон Республики Беларусь от 16 декабря 2008 г. № 2-З «Об охране атмосферного воздуха», National Register 2/1554, Национальный реестр правовых актов Республики Беларусь, 2009 г., № 4 (published 9 January 2009)
evidence: Computed, not stated on a page: Art. 47 "Настоящий Закон вступает в силу через шесть месяцев после его официального опубликования, за исключением настоящей статьи и статьи 46, которые вступают в силу со дня официального опубликования"; the portal card https://pravo.by/document/?guid=3961&p0=H10800002 (opened 2026-11-03) gives "опубликован - 9 января 2009 г." and no commencement date. The date is the day after the six months end, the way the portal dates its cards for Laws 294-Z (published 2023-07-25, nine months, "26.04.2024") and 295-Z (published 2023-07-22, six months, "23.01.2024"). The earlier provisions (Arts. 46 and 47) took effect on 2009-01-09.
notes: Status in the brief ("to confirm"): the Law governs pollutant emissions into air; the stored 2008 text mentions greenhouse gases only to say that climate effects of GHG that are pollutants fall under air law, and since Law 295-Z (2024-01-23) GHG relations belong to environmental protection law. The record is the 2008 text as published in the register issue (file 2009-4(010-032), the act alone, 23 pages); the amended text is not served free by pravo.by. The card lists later amending laws (293-Z of 2011, 6-Z of 2012, 333-Z of 2015, 295-Z of 2023 and others) that are not in scope except 295-Z. English: no government translation found (law.by, the English face of the portal, lists no translation of this act; minpriroda.gov.by did not answer from the cloud address). title: Law No. 225-Z of 10 May 2007 on Advertising
citation: Закон Республики Беларусь от 10 мая 2007 г. № 225-З «О рекламе», National Register 2/1321, Национальный реестр правовых актов Республики Беларусь, 2007 г., № 119 (published 21 May 2007)
evidence: Computed, not stated on a page: Art. 35 "Настоящий Закон вступает в силу через шесть месяцев после его официального опубликования, за исключением настоящей статьи и статьи 34, которые вступают в силу со дня официального опубликования"; the portal card https://pravo.by/document/?guid=3961&p0=H10700225 (opened 2026-11-03) gives "опубликован - 21 мая 2007 г." and no commencement date. The date is the day after the six months end (same method as by-law-air-protection-2008).
notes: Umbrella for misleading claims: Art. 26 defines improper advertising, including "недобросовестная" advertising that contains false or otherwise unreliable information about goods or the advertiser's activity. The Law has no provision on environmental claims; the word экология appears only in the restrictions on advertising in media specialising in ecology. The record is the 2007 text as published, cut from the register issue file 2007-119(012-056), which holds acts 220-Z to 227-Z (the cut runs from the heading of 225-Z to the signature line after Art. 35). The card lists many later amending laws (428-Z of 2008, 95-Z of 2009, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2021, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026), none stored.
